[Intro]
[C#5]
Demonic laughter
your cremation Your
lungs gasp for air
but are
filled with blood

[Verse 1]
[F#5]
A sudden crack as I crushed your
skull The remind of your life
flashes by A life
that soon won't be Smiling with
axe in my hand Evil's rotten hand you'll see

[Chorus]
I come forward
Deathcrush

[Verse 2]
I'll send you to your maker
I'll send you to your death
Death nicely crucified
Death, heads on stakes

[Chorus]
The
barbeque has just be-
gun
Deathcrush
Deathcrush
Deathcrush

[Intro]
[C#5]

[Verse 3]
[F#5]
Crush crush

[Chorus]
Deathcrush
Death-
crush
